statement: Counter-example: an author-written currency claim on the record. An authored `**Currency:** current` line MUST NOT override the graph, which says the record is historical.

reason: An authored currency claim records what was true when someone last remembered to edit that file. The graph records what is true now. Honouring the authored claim reintroduces the stale flag the derivation rule exists to remove.
